items.title: Mose Allison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He has an uncle, Pete Figlia

ctx.x: They’d moved to Florida, and we used to contact them in Florida, and they would never give the rights back.

When the copyright ran out and you tried to renew it yourself, they said someone else had already... So then he passed it on to... He has an uncle, Pete Figlia, who lives in Brooklyn or the Bronx... When we finally got an attorney...you got an attorney who immediately got them back. I don’t know why. We had other attorneys who said they couldn’t do it. But Roberta got the rights back. Because she discovered that he really would have owed us a huge amount of money. We were supposed to be collecting half of…
Mose has stated on public record that this is the case.
